name: n11-cutthrough
title: Store-and-forward versus cut-through
spec: Two timelines of one frame through a switch. Top 'Store-and-forward': receive the whole frame, verify FCS, then forward; latency grows with frame size (9000-byte jumbo on 10 Gb/s needs 7.2 us to serialise). Bottom 'Cut-through': starts forwarding as soon as the destination header is read; latency roughly constant, hundreds of nanoseconds; cost: corrupt frames may get through, the last hop's FCS check drops them (orange). Footer formula in monospace: 'Serialization delay = frame bits / link rate'. Note: port-to-port latency typically 300 ns to 1 us.
cap: Store-and-forward checks the whole frame first, while cut-through starts sending after the destination header.

name: n11-portmodes
title: Access, trunk and native VLAN ports
spec: A switch in the middle. Left: three hosts on access ports labelled 'Access: one VLAN, frames leave untagged'. Right: trunk link to a second switch labelled 'Trunk: multiple VLANs with 802.1Q tags (allowed list)', with one VLAN on it shown untagged and labelled 'Native (untagged) VLAN'. Orange warning: 'Mismatched native VLANs leak traffic across VLANs and trigger STP warnings'. Bottom practices strip: 'do not use VLAN 1', 'prune trunks', 'black-hole VLAN for unused ports'.
cap: Access ports carry one untagged VLAN, trunks carry many tagged VLANs, and the native VLAN is the one sent untagged.

name: n11-intervlan
title: Inter-VLAN routing
spec: Panel A 'Router-on-a-stick': one trunk from a switch to a router with sub-interfaces eth0.10 and eth0.20, each holding the gateway IP of its VLAN. Panel B 'SVI / IRB': an interface per VLAN on an L3 switch. Panel C 'Data centre': VLAN gateway moves to the leaf switch; VLANs rarely extend beyond a rack or pair of leaves; stretch with EVPN/VXLAN (chapter 2.17). Monospace for sub-interface names. Orange note: 'A VLAN is a closed broadcast domain, so different VLANs need an L3 gateway'.
cap: Hosts in different VLANs reach each other only through a layer 3 gateway, built as sub-interfaces, SVIs or on the leaf.
